text:
samir: heads up — gha nightly evals started failing on runner-3 last night. artifacts aren't being uploaded, looks like a 409 conflict from s3. @jin any idea?

jin: seeing the same. error in logs: `Upload failed: 409 Conflict - object already exists` from our artifact step.

marta: did we keep the same artifact key scheme when we moved the orchestrator from Buildkite -> GH Actions? that would cause dedupe collisions when concurrency overlaps.

samir: yep that's my suspicion. we copied the old key format `evals/nightly/<model>/<shard>.tar.gz` and GH Actions runs concurrently sometimes. buildkite used unique build numbers which avoided collision.

jin: ah — GH Actions concurrency config is currently:
```
schedule:
  - cron: '0 04 * * *'
concurrency:
  group: evals-nightly
  cancel-in-progress: false
```
That groups all runs into a single concurrency bucket but doesn't add run-specific suffixes to artifact keys.

ci-bot: recent failed run: https://github.com/redwood-inference/evals/actions/runs/12345

marta: we should make uploads idempotent or include `github.run_id` in the artifact prefix. simplest fix:
```
key: evals/nightly/${{ github.run_id }}/${{ matrix.model }}/shard-{{ matrix.shard }}.tar.gz
```

samir: agree. also for PR gating we want a quick smoke that exercises the upload path. currently PRs gate on full eval which takes 40m. propose adding a `pr-smoke` job that runs a single shard and validates upload+download.

jin: I'll add the run_id prefix and a short `pr-smoke` workflow that uses `actions/cache` to verify roundtrip. also add a retry on the s3 `put` step (2 retries, exponential backoff).

marta: for the nightly backfill we need to dedupe existing artifacts. we can run a one-off job that moves collisions to `archive/<run_id>-collision/` so the new scheme can proceed.

samir: sounds good. can we also gate merges: if `pr-smoke` fails, show a helpful status with link to the failing artifact logs? it's currently buried.

jin: will add a `pr-smoke/status` check with a link to logs and an `artifact-checker` message. also update the dashboard to show upload latencies per runner.

ci-bot: @samir assigned to jin for GH Actions changes, marta for backfill script. @jin will open PR with changes and tag `eng-ml`.

samir: thanks — if anyone sees more 409s tonight, ping me and drop the run id. :thumbsup:

marta: noted. i'll draft the backfill plan tomorrow and post here.

jin: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/evals/pull/987 — includes run_id prefix, retries, and `pr-smoke` workflow. please review.

samir: reviewing now. quick nits on yaml but overall good. once merged we'll schedule the backfill in a maintenance window.

marta: adding to calendar: maintenance 2026-03-25 02:00 UTC.

ci-bot: job done: nightly scheduler updated, alert thresholds adjusted for upload errors.

samir: nice. thanks everyone. :rocket:
